component.name: Soyeht
component.summary: Terminals and coding agents in one workspace

description.p: Soyeht puts terminals, coding agents, files and web pages side by side in one workspace. The agents you already use run in panes, can read each other's work, and ask for your attention only when they need you.
An engine and a terminal supervisor run in the background so that your terminals and agents keep running when you close the window.
